create.name: Glorify
create.bio:
Glorify is a Christian devotional app run by TUPOE Ltd, a company registered in the United Kingdom, with its material also offered in Spanish and Portuguese. It aims to help people build a steady daily habit of time with God, whatever their stage of faith, and says its content is checked by a team of theologians for faithfulness to Scripture.

The heart of the app is a short daily routine: an opening quote, a Bible passage, a written and audio devotional on that passage, a song of worship and a biblical affirmation to carry through the day. Alongside this are guided audio meditations, including a scripture walk set against filmed landscapes, quiet breathing practices that turn attention to Jesus, multi-part courses with pastors and teachers on matters of faith, and a worship music library. A community space lets members share prayer requests, give thanks for answered prayers and discuss a daily question. The app is free to download, with a paid membership for the full library. The company has recently merged with Confidein and now also sells a prayer ring, a separate product not covered here. Its blog carries free collections of prayers and Bible verses for reflection.

free_resources.title: 11 Inspirational Prayers for Inner Peace and Guidance
free_resources.description: A free blog collection of short Christian prayers, starting with the Lord's Prayer and including prayers for strength, guidance and peace, with a note on adapting them into your own words.

free_resources.title: 24 Christmas Bible Verses For Meditation
free_resources.description: A free set of Christmas Scripture passages from the prophets and the Gospels, each grouped with a short prompt for quiet reflection on the birth of Jesus.
